one_liner: Deployable DoD contract administrator who oversees defense contractors' compliance, payments and closeouts, including 6-9 month deployments to austere war-zone locations.
fit_summary: This GS-11 job requires a bachelor's degree plus a year of GS-9-level contract administration (FAR and DFARS clauses, modifications, financing, deficiency reports), and graduate education can't substitute at this grade. Daniel's proposal and purchasing work at IEM was contractor-side and pre-award, so it likely won't meet the bar, and the war-zone deployment requirement is a major commitment.
eligibility: Open to the public and military spouses, so no federal status is needed; Direct Hire means veterans' preference and ranking don't apply.
Basic Contracting Requirement: a baccalaureate degree from an accredited institution is required, and you must submit transcripts (unofficial accepted).
One year of specialized experience equivalent to GS-09 in contract review, FAR/DFAR clauses, modifications, financing and contract deficiency reports; education cannot substitute at GS-11.
You must be able to obtain and maintain a Secret clearance.
You must be able to deploy for 6-9 months to forward operating austere locations in war zones.
strategy: Skip this one: it requires a year of GS-9-level government contract administration, and his proposal and purchasing work at IEM was contractor-side and pre-award.
GS-7 or GS-9 1102 trainee postings open to the public are the better start, with this kind of role as a later target.
resume_bullets: Procured and tracked medical supplies for COVID-19 sites in six states, with pivot-table reports on spending (2021–2022).
Worked on site at COVID-19 mass care sites as assistant to project managers (2021–2022).
interview_questions: Describe a time you found a contractor or project not meeting contract requirements. What did you do?
How familiar are you with the FAR and DFARS, and how would you check a new contract for required clauses?
Why do you want a deployable position, and how have you prepared for a 6-9 month austere deployment?
Walk us through how you would approach closeout of a contract with unresolved funding or deliverables.
watch_outs: Deployment to war zones for 6-9 months is mandatory, not optional.
Without real GS-09-level contracting experience you will likely be rated ineligible; policy knowledge and relationship skills do not count toward it.
The posting lists no promotion potential, and you must obtain a Secret clearance.
